question: Which port is situated at the entrance of the Zuari estuary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mormugao.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

**Marmagao Port**

__
 
• It is situated at the entrance of the **Zuari estuary**, **is a natural harbour in Goa.**
 
• It gained significance after its remodelling in 1961 to handle iron-ore exports to Japan.
 
• The construction of Konkan railway has considerably extended the hinterland of this port.
 
• Karnataka, Goa, and Southern Maharashtra constitute its hinterland.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****New Mangalore**

 
• **New Mangalore Port is a small water, all-weather port at Panambur, Mangalore in Karnataka state in India,** which is the deepest inner harbour on the west coast.
 
• It is the only major port of Karnataka and the seventh largest port in India. It is operated by the New Mangalore Port Trust.
 
• It **caters to the export of Kudremukh iron ore and iron concentrates**.
 
• It also handles fertilizers, edible oils, and polished granite stone.

**Haldia Port**

 
• **Haldia port or Haldia Dock Complex has been built at the meeting place of the Haldi River and Hooghly River.**
 
• Kolkata Port Trust has been created in this port as the port's partner.
 
• It is an **official dock complex.**
 
• It has a vast hinterland comprising the entire northeast of India including West Bengal, Bihar, Jharkhand, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Assam, North East Hill States, Nepal and Bhutan, and also the Autonomous Region of Tibet (China).

**Jawaharlal Nehru Port**

 
• **This port is also known as Nhava Sheva port, is the largest container port in India.**
 
• It is situated about 14 kilometres south of Bombay city.
 
• It **was commissioned on 26th May 1989**
 
• **It handles the majority of India’s containerized trade, accounting for around 50% of the total containerized cargo volume, across the major ports of India. **
 
• It is ranked 33rd in the list of top 100 Container Ports globally.
